title: ApexFlow
description: A code-first durable workflow orchestration engine with zero infrastructure to manage. Replaces heavyweight orchestrators and fragile task queues with native Python ergonomics and a turnkey cloud control plane.
summary: Engineered a distributed workflow runtime featuring step-level memoization, a zero-ops PostgreSQL queue, client-side zero-knowledge encryption, and a Next.js 14 observability dashboard.
impact: Eliminates infrastructure overhead by replacing complex clusters (Temporal/Celery) with raw PostgreSQL concurrency (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) and worker-side authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption.
features: Durable Step Checkpointing: Memoizes steps (await ctx.step) to resume instantly from failed steps without restarting
Zero-Knowledge Encryption: Client-side AES-256-GCM payload encryption with browser Web Crypto decryption
PostgreSQL-Powered Queue Engine: High-throughput distributed dequeuing using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED without Redis/Kafka
Transparent Payload Offload: Payloads >250KB offloaded to Cloudflare R2 / S3 via lightweight pointer references
Loop-Safe Execution: Scoped to (step_name, step_order) guaranteeing safe step memoization inside loops
Next.js Observability Dashboard: Full execution timelines, error tracebacks, and live worker status
highlights: Zero-ops control plane connecting workers via a single API key
Built-in time-travel debugging and step-level checkpoint forking
Worker heartbeat telemetry with automatic lease recovery (locked_until)

title: InboxOrchestrator AI
tagline: Autonomous Email Workflow & Semantic Intelligence Platform
description: An autonomous email workflow and semantic intelligence platform that ingests real-time email communication, extracts deterministic tasks, and maintains SLA-aware thread lifecycles.
summary: Architected an asynchronous email ingestion engine with self-healing ML recovery, a cost-optimized hybrid AI pipeline, and vector search on Supabase.
impact: Reduced LLM token consumption by ~70–80% using local NLP triage and delta summarization, while guaranteeing idempotent task extraction via MD5 action fingerprinting.
features: Autonomous Background Daemons: Gmail REST ingestion + self-healing MLRecoveryOrchestrator daemon
Cost-Optimized Hybrid AI: Local PyTorch classification + spaCy entity extraction + Gemini delta summaries
Deterministic Task Deduplication: MD5 action fingerprinting with PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SLA-Aware State Machine: 5-stage lifecycle (needs_action, awaiting_reply, follow_up, etc.) with automated escalation
Dynamic Semantic Search: 3-tier similarity threshold schedule using local embeddings in Supabase pgvector
Feature-Sliced Next.js UI: Modular web client built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Radix UI
highlights: Delta Prompt Strategy: Passes only summary delta + new message, avoiding full transcripts
Google Calendar Sync: One-click export of structured tasks to Google Calendar via OAuth scopes
Local 384-d vector embeddings generated via all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in Supabase

title: Garments Inventory System (FabricFlow)
description: Production-grade backend system for enterprise garments inventory, order management, and granular role-based access control.
impact: Engineered session-based authentication with Redis, raw SQL query optimizations, full Dockerization, and comprehensive Jest test coverage.
summary: Operational backend engineered for reliable inventory tracking, bulk order pipelines, and multi-tier user permissions.
features: Granular role-based access control (RBAC)
High-throughput Redis-backed session management
Raw SQL performance tuning for complex inventory aggregates
Comprehensive Jest test suites covering critical API endpoints
highlights: Dockerized container setup for reproducible environments
Sub-millisecond session validation via Redis cache
Strict relational integrity across order and garment entities

title: CodeBlog API
description: Modular RESTful blogging engine built with Spring Boot, featuring layered architecture, JWT authentication, and relational data persistence.
impact: Implemented clean package-by-feature structure with decoupled services, secure controllers, and transactional database integrity.
summary: Modular API with strict separation of authentication, publication workflows, and community comments.
features: Stateless JWT-based authentication and route authorization
Comprehensive CRUD workflows for articles and threaded comments
Layered domain service design adhering to SOLID principles
highlights: Structured error response contracts and input validation

title: MiniChess Engine
description: Optimized 5x6 MiniChess AI engine featuring alpha-beta pruning, dynamic move ordering heuristics, and quiescence tactical search.
impact: Implemented transposition table caching for rapid state evaluation and pruning suboptimal game tree branches.
summary: Tactical chess engine engineered with minimax optimizations and compact board state evaluations.
features: Alpha-beta pruning core algorithm
Heuristic move ordering to maximize cutoff efficiency
Quiescence search preventing the horizon effect
highlights: Transposition tables with Zobrist hashing concepts
Optimized evaluation function weighing mobility and piece values
